author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at Witchmarsh: Tea Party of the Damned in this trailer for the upcoming action RPG set in Jazz Age New England. Party-based exploration, character management and fast-paced combat collide in this platformer-cRPG hybrid game. Get a peek at gameplay, learn more about the story, and check out the world in this trailer for Witchmarsh: Tea Party of the Damned. author: GameTrailers
description:
Kiborg: Descent is available now on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and Xbox One. Watch the Kiborg: Descent launch trailer for this expansion that continues the story of Kiborg and brings new locations, weapons, enemies, and lore to the rogue-lite beat'em up game. 

The line between memory and nightmare is fading. Morgan, worn down by the endless cycle of violence, realizes the key to his freedom lies below all the levels he has conquered—in the most secret depths of the Omega-201 tower. Where KENKOU hides its darkest secrets, and the Substance gains a will of its own.

To survive, old grudges must be forgotten. A threat looms over the colony so great that even the fiercest of rivals are forced to become allies.
title: Kiborg: Descent - Official Launch Trailer

description:

In a world of total control and endless wars, you are John Holden, an AWOL soldier trapped in a grim, war-torn town. Use every available trick to survive and escape this damned city: break into houses, steal food and medicine, hone your thieving skills, and influence the fate of its citizens.

Deserter will be available on PC in 2026.

Dead or Alive 6 Last Round and Dead or Alive 6 Last Round Core Fighters will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Windows PC via Steam on June 25, 2026.

Dead or Alive 6 Last Round is the definitive version of Dead or Alive 6, which was originally released in 2019. In addition, characters such as Kasumi and Marie Rose will receive five costumes inspired by other Team Ninja games.
